title: PAH-OMC-020 fixed-n F7--F9 to F10 conditional implication
question: Do the pinned F7 radial residual, F8 stationary-tail and F9 endpoint-preserving cell arguments logically imply uniform fixed-n temporal correlation convergence when their inherited analytic hypotheses are stated explicitly?
finding: Yes as a conditional implication: at fixed n, the finite-fibre variation-of-constants modulus, the R-511 compact-cutoff residual estimate, stationary L1 tail removal and the R-509 half-open cell passage combine by the triangle inequality to give F10. The implication is not an unconditional temporal theorem because the PAH-specific compact modulus, Duhamel domain and all-test time-uniform cell hypotheses are not independently discharged here.
decision_reason: This is a genuine fixed-n proof-spine advance rather than a new finite table. It isolates exactly which inherited analytic hypotheses are load-bearing, checks the finite reversible-fibre algebra independently, and leaves the varying-space and anchored-n obligations untouched.
boundary: Exact PAH-001 functional and original directed rates, labelled state, original external Markov time, two-row G_n and j-before-n order. No rate, state, carrier, regulator, conditional averaging or time interpretation is changed.
method: Pin PAH-001, OMC-016, OMC-018 and the OMC-020 preregistration/work note together with the existing endpoint, fibre and quantifier audits.
Verify the finite label-fibre two-state generator algebra and variation-of-constants modulus shape on an exact Fraction fixture.
Verify the rational F7/F8 two-term decomposition and the ordered j-then-cutoff limits on labelled diagnostic fixtures.
Run separate primary, non-importing independent and hostile lanes plus the existing PahOmc020 Lean compilation, and record all unresolved hypotheses instead of promoting them.
next_action: Discharge the three conditional analytic hypotheses for the exact PAH source or produce an exact counterexample; only then consider unconditional fixed-n admission before testing N2a--N2d and the anchored n passage.
revisit_condition: Reopen when a source-grounded compact fibre modulus, a Duhamel domain estimate for Q_n(t)g_K and an all-test time-uniform cell theorem are supplied with unchanged parent hashes.
non_claims: No unconditional fixed-n temporal theorem, common-Hilbert U_n, Mosco liminf, boundary escape, R-512 minimal-form selection or PAH-OMC-020 completion.
No physical Pre-A, spacetime, QFT, gravity, continuum, mass-gap, Yang--Mills or TOE conclusion; no Q3LOCK or TECT-YM import.
Existing Lean compilation covers only finite algebraic consequences and not the measure-theoretic implication.
verification_summary: Primary, independent, hostile and integrated replay commands pass. Every lane records temporal_verdict=IN_PROGRESS and physical_promotion=false; R-513 is conditional only.
